descriptor: Seed-Conditioned Behavioral Fingerprints, Same-Seed Replay Determinism, Cross-Archive Signature Transport, Fresh-Seed Out-of-Sample Prediction & Hosted-Inference Randomness Decomposition

predecessor.key_result: After explicit seed × temporal-wave orthogonalization, temporal common-mode structure did not survive Holm correction, while Gemini explicit-seed structure survived in both semantic twins and disjoint frozen panels.

theoretical_reframing.problem: P47 establishes between-seed heterogeneity, but heterogeneity alone does not make a seed a scientific state coordinate. A nominal API input may index a one-off realization without repeatability, transport, or predictive structure.
authority_ladder: SEED PARAMETER: a user-supplied nominal API value.
REPRODUCIBLE INTERVENTION: the same seed recreates a seed-specific deviation pattern under exact replay.
TRANSPORTABLE COORDINATE: seed identity remains recognizable after an archive-isomorphic lexical/history renaming.
RANDOMIZATION LAW: previously unseen seeds occupy a response subspace learned prospectively from old seeds rather than generating arbitrary cell-wise patterns.
theoretical_reframing.central_question: Does an API seed merely label stochastic draws, or does it select a reproducible and transportable mode of behavioral susceptibility over representation space?

scientific_question: For Gemini under the P42-frozen response contract, do P47 seed-conditioned behavioral fingerprints reproduce on exact same-archive replay, survive a fresh semantically isomorphic archive namespace, and constrain the response geometry of entirely fresh seeds out of sample?

frozen_panel.construction: All 32 canonical R/F/H/T/L vertices × valid/null twins. Exactly one alias per vertex, alias=ABCD[vertex_index mod 4].
frozen_panel.selection_authority: Deterministic index rule fixed independently of P47 effect sizes.

execution_lanes.old_seed_exact_replay: 8 old seeds × 64 exact P47-namespace cells = 512 calls.
execution_lanes.old_seed_fresh_archive: 8 old seeds × 64 semantically isomorphic fresh-namespace cells = 512 calls.

fresh_archive_transformation.scope: Lexical/source/history/filler/archive identifiers are replaced prospectively while semantic relations, representation operators R/F/H/T/L, claim, intervention labels and adjudication stay fixed.
fresh_archive_transformation.purpose: Test archive-isomorphism transport rather than exact-string memorization.

exact_replay_identity.object: For the eight old seeds, cell-centered 64-dimensional failure fingerprint from P47 versus exact P48 replay.
exact_replay_identity.statistic: Mean diagonal cosine similarity across matching seeds.
exact_replay_identity.null: Exact 8! permutation of seed labels on the replay matrix.
exact_replay_identity.meaning: Tests whether seed identity is a reproducible intervention coordinate under identical archive semantics and surface.

old_seed_cross_archive_identity.object: P47 old-seed fingerprints versus P48 fresh-archive fingerprints for the same eight seeds.
old_seed_cross_archive_identity.meaning: Tests whether seed identity transports across an archive-isomorphic representation change.

fresh_seed_cross_archive_identity.object: Fresh-seed fingerprints in old versus fresh archive namespaces.
fresh_seed_cross_archive_identity.meaning: Tests whether archive transport generalizes to seeds never observed in P47.

fresh_seed_old_archive_subspace.object: Projection energy of fresh-seed centered fingerprints onto the full nonzero row-space learned from P47 old-seed centered fingerprints.
fresh_seed_old_archive_subspace.rank_rule: Use the complete nonzero SVD row-space of the P47 training matrix; no rank tuning.
fresh_seed_old_archive_subspace.statistic: Mean fraction of fresh fingerprint squared norm captured by the frozen training row-space.
fresh_seed_old_archive_subspace.null: 5000 common random cell-coordinate permutations of the fresh-seed matrix.
fresh_seed_old_archive_subspace.meaning: Out-of-sample prediction of behavioral modes, not numerical prediction from seed magnitude.

fresh_seed_fresh_archive_subspace.object: Same frozen P47 row-space tested on fresh seeds in the fresh archive namespace.
fresh_seed_fresh_archive_subspace.meaning: Joint fresh-seed + cross-archive transport of the learned response subspace.

secondary_decomposition.raw_agreement: Same-seed same-archive agreement, same-seed cross-archive agreement, and average different-seed agreement.
secondary_decomposition.seed_separation: Within-seed fingerprint distance versus between-seed distance.
secondary_decomposition.singular_spectrum: P47 old-seed effect singular values and effective rank.
secondary_decomposition.fresh_projection_by_seed: Per-fresh-seed projection fraction into the frozen old-seed effect subspace.
secondary_decomposition.cell_susceptibility: Cells with largest between-seed variance, descriptive only.

gates.technical: All 2048 calls must be exact-schema successful; otherwise P48 enters TECHNICAL_HOLD and only failed calls may be recovered.
gates.reproducible_intervention: Exact-replay identity statistic is positive and its Holm-adjusted test rejects.
gates.transportable_coordinate: Reproducible-intervention gate plus both old-seed and fresh-seed cross-archive identity tests reject after Holm correction.
gates.randomization_law: Transportable-coordinate gate plus both fresh-seed subspace tests reject after Holm correction.
gates.no_numeric_seed_geometry: Seed integers are treated as nominal labels. No regression on seed value, seed distance, parity, or ordering is permitted.

killed: Hosted LLM nondeterminism itself is not novel.
Repeated-run agreement metrics are not novel.
The mere fact that a seed changes output is not a sufficient theoretical contribution.
novelty_kill_and_literature.canonical_drive_source: Atıl et al. (2025), Non-Determinism of “Deterministic” LLM System Settings in Hosted Environments, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.eval4nlp-1.12.
novelty_kill_and_literature.surviving_candidate: A prospective authority ladder from nominal seed parameter to reproducible intervention to archive-transportable coordinate to out-of-sample response subspace, tested on representation-conditioned behavioral susceptibility rather than benchmark-level accuracy.

harvest_linkage: XLVII: uniqueness burden and metamorphic-oracle bridge — cross-archive isomorphism is a transport test, not cosmetic replication.
XLVIII: simulator/model/world and discrepancy distinctions — hosted seed effects remain API-level observables.
XLIX: branch geometry before compression and Branch Sufficiency Witness — a finite seed list is not a law until fresh-seed structure is predicted.
frozen_rules: No cell or seed is selected by P47 effect magnitude.
Seed numbers are nominal interventions, not a metric space.
Same-seed reproducibility is necessary but insufficient for archive transport.
Archive transport is necessary but insufficient for a fresh-seed law.
The fresh-seed law concerns a response subspace/distribution, not prediction of a fresh seed's identity from its integer value.
No neural RNG-state, hardware, batching, or provider mechanism is identified by P48.
No threshold, SVD rank rule, null model, or multiplicity rule may change after P48 outcomes.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P48 alone.
